Definition EM_Comparison_Algebra (c : C) : TAlgebra Adjunction_Induced_Monad (U c) := Build_TAlgebra ... (fmap[U] (@counit _ _ _ _ A c)) ... — K sends c to the algebra ⟨U c, U ε_c⟩ (Mac Lane's ⟨Ga, Gε_a⟩).
Definition EM_Comparison_fmap {c c'} (h : c ~> c') : TAlgebraHom ... (fmap[U] h) ... — K acts on arrows as U h (Mac Lane's K f = G f).
Theorem EM_Comparison_Forget : EM_Forget (Adjunction_Induced_Monad) ◯ EM_Comparison ≈ U. — G^T ∘ K = G, with identity iso components.
Theorem EM_Comparison_Free : EM_Comparison ◯ F ≈ EM_Free (Adjunction_Induced_Monad). — K ∘ F = F^T, via identity-underlying isomorphisms.
Definition Adjunction_Induced_Monad : @Monad D (U ◯ F) := Build_Monad ... (ret = η) ... (join = fmap[U] (counit A (F x)) = U ε F) — the monad T = ⟨GF,η,GεF⟩ that K compares against.

evidence.intree_statement: Definition Monadic {C D : Category} (U : C ⟶ D) : Type := ∃ (F : D ⟶ C) (A : F ⊣ U), EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A). — U is monadic when it has a left adjoint whose Eilenberg–Moore comparison functor is an equivalence of categories.
Definition Identity_Monadic {C : Category} : Monadic Id[C] := (Id[C]; (Adjunction_Id; identity_monadic)). — a concrete inhabitant of the Monadic predicate (the identity functor).

statement_record.book: A right adjoint G is monadic (tripleable) when the comparison functor K:A→X^T is an isomorphism of categories; some authors (Barr–Wells) require only that K be an equivalence of categories.

Fixpoint flatten (xs : list (list A)) : list A := match xs with nil => nil | cons x xs' => app x (flatten xs') end. — the multiplication μ: 'concatenates a list-of-lists into a single list by repeated app, i.e. the monad multiplication μ : list (list A) → list A of the free-monoid monad' (Mac Lane's 'erase the outer brackets').

Program Definition list_Functor : IsFunctor list_Functor := { a_fmap := list_Functor }. — 'list is a genuine endofunctor on Coq, with fmap = List.map' (the three functor obligations discharged by induction), so the underlying endofunctor W is categorical.
